Transaction reversals (`Ledger.reverse(transactionId, date)`, shipped last release)
don't work. Reversing a plain transfer fails straight away:

    com.example.ledger.LedgerException: transaction TX-00003 is unbalanced: entries sum to -200.00 USD
        at com.example.ledger.Ledger.post(Ledger.java)
        at com.example.ledger.Ledger.reverse(Ledger.java)

Accounting's rules for reversals, as documented on the methods:

* a reversal undoes every leg of the original, so all affected balances return to what
  they were;
* it is booked on the date passed to `reverse`, never back-dated: if we reverse a
  March transaction on 2 April, March balances and statements must not change;
* a transaction can be reversed only once, and a reversal can't itself be reversed.
  Both attempts must be refused with a `LedgerException` and leave the books
  untouched.

Please make reversals work according to these rules.
